chk_employee_identification_valid_date_r.name: chk_employee_identification_valid_date_range
chk_employee_identification_valid_date_r.value:
"employee_identifications"."expiry_date" IS NULL
          OR "employee_identifications"."issue_date" IS NULL
          OR "employee_identifications"."expiry_date" >= "employee_identifications"."issue_date"

chk_employee_identification_valid_hijri_.name: chk_employee_identification_valid_hijri_date_range
chk_employee_identification_valid_hijri_.value:
"employee_identifications"."expiry_date_hijri" IS NULL
          OR "employee_identifications"."issue_date_hijri" IS NULL
          OR "employee_identifications"."expiry_date_hijri" >= "employee_identifications"."issue_date_hijri"

chk_iqama_comment_thread_fields.name: chk_iqama_comment_thread_fields
chk_iqama_comment_thread_fields.value:
(
          "iqama_renewal_case_comments"."parent_comment_id" is null
          and "iqama_renewal_case_comments"."thread_root_id" is null
        )
        or
        (
          "iqama_renewal_case_comments"."parent_comment_id" is not null
          and "iqama_renewal_case_comments"."thread_root_id" is not null
        )
